body_md:
Siege defense might sound somewhat daunting, but this can be mich simpler than we might think. Cities are made of Zones and Structures, some of which have Linkages, Containment, etc. This is exactly the same outline as a Battlefield. So, any City can be a Battlefield. Your own Outpost is a City, so it can also be a Battlefield. One of the only things cosider further is how you get Armies for defense. Simple enough, just like a City does.

#### Raising Armies
When Players Raise an Army to defend their Outpost, its Might is reduced, temporarily, by 3. This temporary penalty is replaced, upon the Return of the Army.
**Lasting Change in Might**

When an Army Returns, roll a Pool of Chaos Dice and, for each 6, the City loses one Might. The size of this Pool depends on the fraction of the Army that Returns.
- All Units Destroyed: `10 Chaos Dice`
- 25% of Units Return: `8 Chaos Dice`
- 50% of Units Return: `6 Chaos Dice`
- 75% of all Units Return: `3 Chaos Dice`
- All Units Return: `1 Chaos Die`
#### A Consideration About Units
Units in Battle that a City can raise are sort of generalized abstractions, and more things are possible. For example, the sample Units described with Battles have Commanders and a few other unique Units. These come in when the narrative demands. For example, when a notable Ally is a Friend of Death, include them (assuming that NPC agrees to help.)

	`Tier: T| Durability: T`
	`Cost: 20k×T×(Durability)`
	`Resources-F: -| G: -|`
	Dedicated to training the body, the Gymnasium is essential for providing an Outpost with muscle trained for purpose.
	*Traits*
	- `The Gymnasium can be used to advance one's Training in Athletics, Tumble, and Brawling without a Mentor.`
	- `Within a Gymnasium, everyone can treat its Tier as their rating for Vitality and Action, for the purpose of Activities.`

Structure: **Undercroft**
	`Tier: T| Durability: T`
	`Cost: 20k×T×(Durability)`
	`Resources-F: -| G: 1|`
	The underbelly of an Outpost is still a valuable resource, those that frequent it often trade in skills well suited for the trickery of the Sea.
	*Traits*
	- `The Undercroft can be used to advance one's Training in Cascade, Guile, Skullduggery, and Assassination without a Mentor.`
	- `The Undercroft is home to dealers in Poisons, at a Tier greater than the Structure's by one.`

Structure: **Reflection Pool**
	`Tier: T| Durability: T`
	`Cost: 20k×T×(Durability)`
	`Resources-F: -| G: -|`
	Stone halls and dim lamps, silent and somber. Reflection Pools are places for recollection and quiet.
	*Traits*
	- `A Reflection Pool can be used to advance one's Training in Iron Will, Wisdom, and Memory without a Mentor.`
	- `Within this Structure, everyone can treat its Tier as their rating for Potence and Resolve, for the purpose of Activities.`

Structure: **Refinery**
	`Tier: T| Durability: T`
	`Cost: 20k×T×(Durability)`
	`Resources-F: 1| G: 1|`
	Stocked with a plethora of tools and the collected knowledge of the Verdun sciences, a Refinery provides an Outpost with the means to ascend towards the sophistication of the Arks.
	*Traits*
	- `A Refinery can be used to advance one's Training in Alchemy, and Artifice without a Mentor. The Tier of Items you make within a Refinery is greater by 1, up to a maximum of 4.`
	- `The Refinery's equipment can be used to produce Artifice and do Alchemy, and its workers sell both kinds of Item, up to one plus the Tier of the Structure.`

Structure: **Hospital**
	`Tier: T| Durability: T`
	`Cost: 20k×T×(Durability)`
	`Resources-F: -| G: 1|`
	The conditions of the Outpost substantially improved the standing of Barbers, as Hospitalers remain in short supply, Surgery becomes a much more precious need.
	*Traits*
	- `The Hospital can be used to advance one's Training in Surgery without a Mentor. Those Trained in Surgery can treat their Training as one greater within the Hospital.`
	- `One can receive Surgery in a Hospital, rolled with a total Bonus of 4 times the Structure's Tier. Depleted Growth Tokens can also be placed in the Hospital, up to 2T, to restore them within 3 Days.`

Structure: **Academy**
	`Tier: T| Durability: T`
	`Cost: 50k×T×(Durability)`
	`Resources-F: -| G: 1|`
	A place of learning, where one may practice and research. Academies are also the place where the Outpost's new generations will learn, adding to the corpus of Verdun understanding as they become the new vessels of their own heritage.
	*Traits*
	- `The Academy can be used to advance one's Training in Scholarship, Tactics, Elocution, or Leadership without a Mentor. The collection of materials within an Academy is fairly extensive. It automatically contains information in the Grasp of a Scholar of twice its Tier, regarding all known Subjects.`
	- `You can pay a Character to engage in the Study Activity for you at an Academy, they are presumed to have Training in Scholarship equal to twice the Structure's Tier and charge a rate of 30T per Opportunity spent.`

body_md:
Gaia was a beautiful world. Lush plains covered most of the land, punctuated with mountains and hills etched with flowing rivers and streams that fed into the World Sea. As the Verdun, its people, had it, it would have been a perfect place, were it not for the Impure; monstrous beings that came from the Depths to prey on the life above. The nations of Gaia waged battles against them that grew into wars. Led by the greatest representatives of the Verdun, they would eventually uncover the source of these unclean creatures.

A lurking evil, the source of monsters, Abbadon lay in the depths of Gaia itself, spewing forth corruption and malice that eventually emerged as the Impure. Upon their discovery, the Verdun resolved to slay it, to put Abbadon to rest for good and all. The Gifted wrought magic into great weapons of war, the Clerics called down instruments of celestial punishment, and the kings and emperors of Gaia sent both warriors and scholars so-armed into the Depth to do this great work.

Many bands and companies of heroes fought with Abbadon, but it was a few that eventually subdued it. The Company of the Prince eventually emerged from the Depths, hailed with thunderous applause and showered with golden gifts of praise for their deed. All the nations of Gaia were full of wine and exuberance, feasts and indulgence that quickly turned to ash on their tongues.

The scholars soon met with their lords in secret, their studies of the stars had of recent days gone awry. The Gifted and other students of the Aether whispered amongst themselves; the invisible breath from which they drew their strength was growing ever fouler. The Clerics witnessed terrible omens, Celestial emissaries growing cold and cruel in their conduct and speech. No one knew who first spoke of the Doom, but all agreed it would shortly arrive. The slaying of Abbadon had undone something vital within Gaia itself. For it was not only the source of Monsters. Whatever had made Gaia had intended Abbadon as a sort of loadstone, a balance to the radiant, subtle field of Arcane potential that suffused its air. Without this, the whole system would collapse, and soon.

With the time they had, the nations ordered their greatest works ever conceived to be built, artisans and machines to build Arks in the guise of greater cities and temples.  Soon, the first fissure lanced up from the World Sea, boiling with molten rock and transmitting a malignance through the Aether worse than even the mightiest of the Impure's vile sorceries.

More sprouted after, crawling across the whole of Gaia, spurred by the collapse of the Aether itself which laid the Gifted low. Soon the air too grew foul and only the Arks' defenses provided breath. The progression of the fissures, having laid all but the Arks in darkness and chaos, wrapped around Gaia entire, shattering and completing the Doom. The Celestials finally closed it from the Outside, wrapped in a crystal sphere, a world of floating Shards pivoting around Black Iron core of Abbadon's prison, now cold and dead.

The Verdun remain in their Arks, scavenging the dead Shards that drift about them. Sending Shard Ship Expeditions with the brave few to scour these for remnants of the Aether, now crystalized Residue, Artifacts of the old world, and anything that could preserve their city until the next dawn. Cursing the Company of the Prince, remembered only as the Company of Fools, the Verdun continue to fight. A churning ever-war against the conditions that they themselves created, no matter how innocently; their greatest foe is the legacy of their own decimation.

Our story begins with a newly formed Expedition bound from the Ark Shard, Vinia. What they find, who does so, and their own survival is up to you.

name: The Sea
summary: Within the Sea, remnants drift, shattered fragments of Gaia scattered by the Doom. The largest of these are Shards, landmasses hundred of Meters in span, held together by convolutions of the Aether. !NU PHB no_DMG/IMAGERY/SHARD_INTERIOR.webp The Shard Sea The current state of that world is important to understanding how one might explore it. Looking from the outside-in, we would see it as follows:
body_md:
*Within the Sea, remnants drift, shattered fragments of Gaia scattered by the Doom. The largest of these are Shards, landmasses hundred of Meters in span, held together by convolutions of the Aether.*
![[NU PHB no_DMG/IMAGERY/SHARD_INTERIOR.webp]]
#### The Shard Sea
The current state of that world is important to understanding how one might explore it. Looking from the outside-in, we would see it as follows:
- **The Shield of Heaven**| `100 Kilometers`: A great, golden sphere set with six Cardinal Points, containing the vastness of the Aether within.
	- This is impenetrable from either direction.
	- At each Cardinal Point, the Luminary Temples hang from the inside of the Shield. At their apex, great points of light emit radiance, believed to be drawn from the Sun itself.
	- Each Luminary is active for 12 or so Hours.
- **The Upper Aether**| `99-60 Kilometers`: Near the Shield itself, this atmosphere is too thin to support any but the lightest vessels, and is crossed by thin wisps and currents of light.
- **The Surface**| `60-30 Kilometers`: Where the Aether is right for both Alembic enginery and for Shards, great remnants of the once-world of Gaia.
	- The Shard Sea is also traversed by the great Arks, the vessels created by the ancient Verdun to withstand the Doom. These are usually located just at the height of the Upper Aether, safe from most debris and Storms.
	- The Aether at this height, especially as one goes lower, tends to be more chaotic, prone to disturbance, and even invasion from Storms from the lower layers.
- **The Shallows**| `30-10 Kilometers`: Inferior to the Sea, the Aether here is still traversable, but very dangerous. Debris-fields, Aetheric disturbances, Storms, and other dangers are common.
- **The Depths**| `10-0 Kilometers`: Barely traversable by Alembic engine, this marks the limit of the known world. Whisps of Dark, extremely dense Corrupted Aether swirl and pulse with currents of deadly power. The few that venture here usually forswear it if they survive at all.
- **The Dark**| `0-? Kilometers`: Below this ebon surface, by necessity of known geometry, Scholars have estimated that more than 10,000 Kilometers of unexplored space exists. An immense, spherical expanse of only the Gods know what. None have ever touched this realm and returned.

**The Aether**
Throughout all layers of the Sea, from the Shield to the Dark below (and even within it, though none know for sure), the Aether pervades. Thin, invisible, air-like, and tasteless, Aether is a primal substance, from which Mages conjure Magic and which, in more perverse states, gives rise to all manner of dangers.
*Aether Disturbances*
	Though Aether cannot be seen under normal circumstance, often significant anomalies and events can give rise to visual effects. Mages, for example, emit bright cobalt-blue flares of light while Channeling. Likewise, the surges within the Dark are presumed to be another kind of visible Aetheric phenomena.
*Aether Cannot Satiate*
	Verdun cannot breath Aether, though it is not normally harmful to do so in small quantities. Rather, Aether is no substitute for a wholesome atmosphere. As such, the Verdun carry their breath in Cannisters and other means, produced by the same Alembics that carry them about.

**Shards in the Sea**
In the Surface layer and into the Shallows, one finds Shards, enormous splinters of Gaia' own surface. Shards are all unique, and are the aim of Expeditioners to find and explore. Parties of intrepid Verdun scour these for their riches in Aetheric Residue, crystalized Magical substances that power Artifice. Likewise, many Shards have other kinds of wealth: food, exotic life, and even Nodes where Residue grows as if it lived and Ruins from before the Doom. Shards are also filled with danger, often in the form of that same exotic life and from the terrain of the Shard itself.
*Typology*
	Shards are usually grouped by Type, representing what kind of Terrain one might expect there. The more common Types are:
	- *Veridian*: Swarming with life and greenery of a thousand kinds.
	- *Arctic*: Clad in a thick coat of rime.
	- *Aether-Touched*: Where Residue forms part of the Shard itself.
	- *Volcanic*: Light with an inner flame and constantly belching smoke.,
*Accessibility*
	One of the quirks of a Shard is its Wake in the local Aether, an effect preventing stable travel by Alembic vessel too near it. Aether Wakes can be quelled, but only by extensive installations into the Shard, Pylons, constructed by Outpost Expeditions.

#### Traversing the Sea

name: The Wheel of Wheels
summary: Verdun scripture is fractured, shards of ancient history, carefully bound together in "The Book of Wheels". Maintained by Nous' Orators, this document represents the collective efforts of the Arks in the last half-millennia to reconstruct their past.
body_md:
Verdun scripture is fractured, shards of ancient history, carefully bound together in "The Book of Wheels". Maintained by Nous' Orators, this document represents the collective efforts of the Arks in the last half-millennia to reconstruct their past.

The Book is organized by subject, and frequently split into smaller sections for use in practical efforts or instruction. For example, the Wheel of Law is often printed as an individual document, held close by Paladins, while the Wheel of Ages and Wheel of Wheels tend to be kept together and used in instructing children.

One of the striking features of these works is their anonymity, the canon of the Book of Wheels requires that the included text be stripped of an author. The opening passage of the Wheel of Wheels, the putative first authored section states:
	*"As Al'Haori stepped beyond the World, enclosing his way and leaving the surface of it clean, so too are pages clean, its letters free from all but meaning. To speak into the Wheel, one must step behind it, to vanish from the sight of its words. Only in silence can the word retain its perfect intention"*
#### The Wheel of the Ages
Usually a preface, this explains the history of the Verdun, as they know it, mostly concerning the Doom and the ensuing construction of the Arks. Six hundred and forty four years have passed, and the first hundred or so are empty, insofar as the records of them have been lost.

**Concerning the Age of Providence**
*"In the Age before, when the sky was endless azure, the Kings built great palaces, surrounding them with cities, immense and adorned with ten thousand hues. We spoke many tongues in these days, clad as to speak of our enmities"*

*"In these days, the Gift was named in truth, for those the Aether blessed could call its name, could see their will unfold as if speaking Al'Haori's own tongue; this was before air itself turned bitter"*

*"The Gods were pleased in our workings, we worshipped the Seven and the lost brother, their Mother, Gaia, and did honor to the silent Father Sky. It was said their servants walked among us then, both those of spirit and those of sparkling substance"*

*"This Age did not lack for strife, for the great Enemy below was awake, its Demons schemed and unleashed fearful troubles whom they could. The plagues and monsters of the Fly, the Empress' murderous plots, all of these were our ancient foe, that against which we mounted our greatest effort, our grand folly"*

**Concerning the Company of Fools**
*"In the Age before, there was a great nation, whose Prince commanded a Company of Thousand warriors, surrounded by thirty three Gifted magician Scholars, whose words could unleash Creation, and guarded by thirty three holy men and women, whose Virtue was the will of the Gods"*

*"The Emperor came into the twilight of life, finding himself with two children, the Prince and his firstborn, Istera, who was a great Scholar, and whose mother he had loved, surpassing that of the Prince, who would succeed him by customary right. So he summoned the Prince and spoke, saying 'Son of mine, you have made a great name for yourself, terrible to our enemies, but in your inmost thoughts, can you find even one who should not bow his head?' and the Prince rejoined 'Father mine, I and my Company are without equal, in Sorcery and Virtue we have no peer, and in heroism, no head may rise to the level of the Thousand Sons.'"*

*"Hearing this, for the Emperor was a man of capacity, both love and terrible cunning, spoke again. 'Fruit of my own victories, do the demons themselves bow to you? I see your eyes glitter and think what pride might undo when I am gone. Address me, my own son, and admit what faults you must, or show me the Lord of Abisa, Abbadon, at your feet. Should I see neither, Istera will rule.' and the Prince left in silence, eyes shining cold, stars in the emptiness beyond"*

**Concerning Abbadon and its Minions**
*"In the depths of the earth, lay the place of the enemy, called Abisa. Its king was named Abbadon, the ruler of the depths and lord of the void. Other than its name, none could be spoken of it, but its servants were many and known, in infamy they reigned across the realms between those of sky and fire."*

*"The Demonic Hosts were led by greater beings, stooping monsters greater than a single body, these lords of Hell fashioned the Infernal beings in their image, as well as the foul Orcs and all monsters who would terrorize the children of Gaia."*

**Concerning the Doom**
*"When the Prince returned, his eyes were dark, as were those of his counselors and remaining host. The Company had plumbed Hell to its deepest, the pit of the dread master. Though he did not bring the body of Abbadon with him, nor would he speak a reason"*

*"At that time, the sky was written with ten thousand portents, signs of woe known only to the keepers of the ways of stars. They hid these signs from all but those who would build the Arks"*

*"And as Gaia was broken, a great darkness enclosed the sky, a Shield in Heaven, through which nothing can be seen, neither moon or star. At the six cardinal points of this lie the Beacons, from which comes the echo of the sun"*
#### Khaoi'ikhon - The Wheel of Wheels
The first scripture describes Creation, the origin of the cosmos from Al'Haori, the Thinker. The primary concepts to be grasped, per the Scholarship of the Arks, are the underlying metaphysical reality, the six Aspects of Creation, which are the Six Great Wheels, the Celestial Bodies, which are the Solar Wheels, and the Unseen places, which are the Wheels Invisible.

**Concerning the Six Great Wheels**
*"And at the inception of Creation, Al'Haori divided his Thought, making each of its parts into a Great Wheel"*

*"Time, the conception of sequence, and of durations great and finite, these formed the span of Wheel of Ages, Tempus"*

*"Space, the geometry of where, here, and there, of touch and emptiness, these became the Wheel of Structures, Cel"*

*"Power, to cause and to be caused, becoming and doing, these are the Wheel of Forces, Rakvis"*

*"Life, the principle of animation and self construction, the greatest of the six, this is the Wheel of Souls, Daimos"*

*"Aether, that which is before everything, the intermediary between Al'Haori's Thought and Being, the Wheel of Emptiness Istari"*

*"Change, the last of the Great Wheels, which is the cycle and nature of act and potentiality, this is the Wheel of Forms Dynamis"*

**Concerning the Solar Wheels**
*"After the division of his Thought, did Al'haori fashion others from the wonder of each Great Wheel, the grand spoke and axis of this was the Sun, the pure light of Power, Space and Time and Change orchestrated their motions, Aether divided the boundaries of them, and upon a few, he invested Life. Each Solar Wheel is as a Branch to the point of the Sun"*

*"In the great depth, Al'Haori placed an insignificant body, a Wheel of ice and darkness to circumscribe the Sun's Splendor, this was called Ek'Zin"*

*"There was a curtain thrown about the span of Gaia, whose glittering shield cloaked it from fallen stars, this was called Rama"*

*"Within the Axis of the Sun, the World was made, blessed and fruitful, each turn of the Six Great was in the honor of this, the crown jewel of all Creation, Gaia"*

*"Beyond the Curtain, he made a grander Wheel, whose face was in eternal turmoil, from thence came the Outer God, Ventus"*

*"About the apex of Gaia, was there Li, the Wheel of the Star, unmoving, about its span, Mana, the Wheel of Moon, upon which the Gods would build their kingdom"*

*"Within the Span of the Sun, a Wheel of fire, an ever moving light of terrible swiftness"*

*"When Al'Haori had stepped beyond, it was said by the Gods, out of all his fashionings, 'what is this stranger here?' for they had seen Hao'Kan, the Wheel from another place"*

The following passages describes a more abstract notion, that of other planes of existence, some of which are taken to constitute an afterlife, others with less clear concepts.

**Concerning the Wheels Invisible**
*"Al'Haori's Thought far exceeded mortal grasp, and more were fashioned than the Wheels of the realms of life, for there are known six unseen Wheels, and it is said countless are yet unfathomed"*

*"Within the depth of Gaia, the place of the enemy, the dwelling of the great beast, Abbadon, which was also called the Hinge of the World, it was called Abisa which was the point of the great folly"*
	Verdun Scholars and Priests tend to argue that Abisa was a real location, something plundered by the Company of Fools. Likewise, both agree that its remains still exist, Abyssal Shards infested with Demons and other monsters.

*"In his Wisdom, Al'Haori fashioned the World to cast away impurity and all defect. Those spiteful ghosts, those unsouled, they fall to the Wheel of mourning, that realm of dead skies and sepulchers. Herod is the name, unspoken"*
	The lowest realm of the afterlife, Herod tends to be conceptualized as a place punishment by Priests, something inflicted on impure souls. Perhaps owing to the very popular epithet that all Mages are impure, Scholars tend to disagree with this, arguing that, if Herod exists at all, the passage is a metaphor for the dissolution of the Soul into nothingness.

*"The paradise of Blessed Souls, Caello, those above the Sky who won joy, it was from this Golden Wheel that Al'Haori fashioned the Gods' servants"*
	Famously a realm of heroes and legends, less is known about the exact meaning of this passage, which the only mention known of Caello. The rumors of contact with Celestials and Priests give contradictory pictures, the former describing a vast world of supernatural mechanisms, and the latter a palatial expanse of sunbeamed halls, wherein the only sounds are music and silence.

*"The quiet world of ever night, walked by those whose lives were not sung, neither in praise or sorrow, Gadal was given to Luna, who gave the judgement of the dead to Mora, receiving those who the Lady of Death would neither castigate nor acclaim"*
	This is the best understood realm, as the Priests of Luna have the ability to bodily enter the Evernight. Investigation by Scholar-Mages often speak of a vastness there, as if it were much larger than it appeared from within. The Ways of the Evernight are thought to divide the realm, like the tales of the moon and its twin sides. The living walk the closer of the two to the waking daylight.

*"Before he stepped beyond the threshold, Al'Haori fashioned Tamrin, a realm of Gods, a timeless remove at the center of Creation from which all that could is seen"*
	The location, embodiment, and exact nature of the Gods is extremely contentious, so much that the exact interpretation of Tamrin is left as a issue of personal faith, if not an almost willful ignorance. Those less faithful are equally split, as the evidence provided in experience and the scant passages about it is sparse.

*"When Creation was finished, the Thinker stepped behind a door of shining dark, the span of this door is Hao, who shuts the way"*
#### The Branches of the Wheel

**Concerning the Origins of the Gods**
*"Upon the making of the world, and the creation of the seven-fold thousand Servants, each of their Choir and purpose, Al'Haori spoke his final words, two names from which would come everything thereafter, ancient Sky, Khaoi, and Allmother Gaia"*

*"From the two words, were born Lumen and Luna, whose powers were Sun and Moon, from them came Telmar, Ventus, Maran, Sylvan, Mora, and Manus, from the last two came first Nous, keeper of the Book of Wheels, and Bella"*

**Concerning the Authorship of the Book**
*"We are the Nameless, servants of the Storyteller whose glory is to be written into the Book, we are the few, we remember"*

**Concerning the Wheel of the Sun**
*"The Sons of Lumen would lead, would guide the children of Gaia and care for their council. Kings and rulers are bound by them, those who would judge the writers of the law"*

**Concerning the Wheel of the Moon**
*"In the Shadow, the Mirror's Chosen are called to know, to disclose the hidden things to those that are owed it, and to conceal from the unrighteous all the greater things"*

**Concerning the Wheel of Law**
*"As the law is authored by kings in Virtue, the law is read by the Paladin, his hammer both justifies and adjudicates it, for the judgement of all save the law's author is his"*

**Concerning the Wheel of Death**
*"When body unleashes its hold on the soul, men ask, whence; it is Mora who is the harvester and guide of the dead, and her Friends of Death are for the living, both to council and to protect against the violations of the mortal order"*

**Concerning the Wheel of Creation**
*"The Forge Priest is thrice blessed, his hands wield the Light of Creation, from this he makes cities, implements, and clean water, with these can he alone forge a people"*

**Concerning the Wheel of Fire**
*"Lastborn, Bella, whose Hospitallers are given the greatest gift, the Flame of Life, her two faces reflect man's origin and end; the man that kills one of her faithful is damned twice"*
text:
Verdun scripture is fractured, shards of ancient history, carefully bound together in "The Book of Wheels". Maintained by Nous' Orators, this document represents the collective efforts of the Arks in the last half-millennia to reconstruct their past.

The Book is organized by subject, and frequently split into smaller sections for use in practical efforts or instruction. For example, the Wheel of Law is often printed as an individual document, held close by Paladins, while the Wheel of Ages and Wheel of Wheels tend to be kept together and used in instructing children.

One of the striking features of these works is their anonymity, the canon of the Book of Wheels requires that the included text be stripped of an author. The opening passage of the Wheel of Wheels, the putative first authored section states:
	*"As Al'Haori stepped beyond the World, enclosing his way and leaving the surface of it clean, so too are pages clean, its letters free from all but meaning. To speak into the Wheel, one must step behind it, to vanish from the sight of its words. Only in silence can the word retain its perfect intention"*
#### The Wheel of the Ages
Usually a preface, this explains the history of the Verdun, as they know it, mostly concerning the Doom and the ensuing construction of the Arks. Six hundred and forty four years have passed, and the first hundred or so are empty, insofar as the records of them have been lost.

*"The Gods were pleased in our workings, we worshipped the Seven and the lost brother, their Mother, Gaia, and did honor to the silent Father Sky. It was said their servants walked among us then, both those of spirit and those of sparkling substance"*

*"This Age did not lack for strife, for the great Enemy below was awake, its Demons schemed and unleashed fearful troubles whom they could. The plagues and monsters of the Fly, the Empress' murderous plots, all of these were our ancient foe, that against which we mounted our greatest effort, our grand folly"*

**Concerning the Company of Fools**
*"In the Age before, there was a great nation, whose Prince commanded a Company of Thousand warriors, surrounded by thirty three Gifted magician Scholars, whose words could unleash Creation, and guarded by thirty three holy men and women, whose Virtue was the will of the Gods"*

So he summoned the Prince and spoke, saying 'Son of mine, you have made a great name for yourself, terrible to our enemies, but in your inmost thoughts, can you find even one who should not bow his head?' and the Prince rejoined 'Father mine, I and my Company are without equal, in Sorcery and Virtue we have no peer, and in heroism, no head may rise to the level of the Thousand Sons.'"*

*"Hearing this, for the Emperor was a man of capacity, both love and terrible cunning, spoke again. 'Fruit of my own victories, do the demons themselves bow to you? I see your eyes glitter and think what pride might undo when I am gone. Address me, my own son, and admit what faults you must, or show me the Lord of Abisa, Abbadon, at your feet. body_md:
**Mage Ward**
	*Runes*: Shell, Distortion, Force
	*Reagents*: A Loop of Residue, Infused in the Ritual.
	*Time*: 1 Minute.
	Like the Wards that preserve the Arks on a smaller scale. A Mage's Ward offers simple physical insulation from potential harm by erecting a wall of thickened air. Few venture far without the Infused Loop somewhere on their person.
	`After completing the incantation, a sphere of translucent energy encases any holding the Infused Loop. Your Ward functions like a Shield, always active, but lacking any Hardness. It has Durability equal to the Ritual Tier. If your Ward is Broken, the Loop is destroyed.`

**Terra Magna Magia**
	*Runes*: Shell, Void, Star
	*Reagents*: As a Magic Circle.
	*Time*: 10 Minutes.
	A more ostentatious Magical work than a Circle, this enclosure of space designates a single Soul, drawing power from other Mages to feed their own.
	`This is created in the same manner as a Magic Circle, but requires multiple Mages. While the Circle remains unbroken, none of its makers but one may Channel. The beneficiary of this Ritual receives a Bonus to their Core Tier, Degree of Arcane, and to their Intelligence equal to the number of other Mages. In exchange, they also suffer 1 point of Permenant Corruption for each which cannot be removed until the Circle is broken, and are unable to leave the Circle or break it themselves.`

**Crystal Sphere**
	*Runes*: Shell, Distortion, Weight, Density, Star.
	*Reagents*: As a Magic Circle.
	*Time*: 1 Hour.
	Protection for longer periods of time for a larger group than a traditional Ward. Crystal Spheres are common tools for Mage Expeditioners spending a night on a Shard.
	`At the conclusion of the Ritual, an opaque mirrored Sphere of force appears around you with a Radius up to 10 Meters. This will mold to obstructions when formed, and close when they are removed. Otherwise, this is a solid wall with a Hardness up to your Influence, and Durability equal to ten times that amount. This Ritual lasts for 24 Hours, or until you Banish the Sphere.`

**The Door in the Eye**
	*Runes*: Eye, Relativity, Presence
	*Reagents*: A body-length mirror with a Price of at least 300 and Sphere of Temporal Residue, consumed in the Ritual.
	*Time*: 1 Hour.
	The past is inaccessible, time a wall over which none can climb. The Door in the Eye is a way through it.
	`At the conclusion of the Ritual, you step through the mirror, into a shadowy reflection of the space you were, but at any point in the past you wish. This is a quasi real space and can be interacted with, but you cannot move further than your Influence from the mirror. No people appear there, and the chosen moment is inert unless you act (though some physical traces like footporints can be found.) When you step back through the mirror, you return to the instant you left and the mirror shatters.`
	`No Mages has ever been able to venture within 100 Years of the events of the Doom with this or any other method of Temporal Magic.`

**Missile Array**
	*Runes*: Force, Spark
	*Reagents*: A Plug of Residue into which the Ritual is Infused.
	*Time*: 1 Hour.
	Intangible machinery able to focus Aether into bolts of pure energy. Arrays like these are a mainstay of practical Mages. While limited in scope, their strength comes from their reliability.
	`After completing this Ritual, you gain the ability to project held Aether into offensive Missiles as a 1 AP Primary Action. Each Missile requires 1 Aether and automatically hits a Target within your Influence. You may create as many Missiles as you like and choose as many Targets.`
	`Each Target hit with a single Missile suffers 3d6 Fire and Piercing Damage. If the same Target is hit with multiple, each Missile after the first increases this single instance of Damage by 1d6.`

name: Rare Pacts
summary: "Oh Spirit of Glory, we invoke you from the endless sands of Perdition, against those ignorant, against the scorn of fools, in spite we name you King in Truth and promise you justice. Dwell in us put your might in our hands and your foes beneath our feet."
body_md:
#### Lucifer, the Son of the Sun
	*"Oh Spirit of Glory, we invoke you from the endless sands of Perdition, against those ignorant, against the scorn of fools, in spite we name you King in Truth and promise you justice. Dwell in us put your might in our hands and your foes beneath our feet."*

The Spirit Lucifer is a jealous lord, covetous as he is violent, as magnificent as vicious. Unknown before the Doom, speculations wild as to his origin, from an incarnation of Verdun spite, an ascendant Binder, or even the Prince of Fools arisen as a new king of Hell.

Binding Lucifer is sacrifice, an exequy of majesty and fire; the Flame of Perdition which his Binders wield is a mystery in itself, almost Holy in aspect, burning with the anger of a soul stoke with the wrongs of a thousand thousand years of ignominy and hatred.

**The Pact**
To receive his Power, Binders abandon all other allegiance, at least so long as his dread eye regards their service.
`For every Round that you benefit from Lucifer's Pact, you must give up the benefits of all other Pacts. If you violate this exchange, you suffer 1 Corruption for each Round. Falling to Lucifer's Pact, you erupt in smoke malign flames. `At any time, you can choose to Wield Perdition's Flame. This is not a Reaction or Action at all, and can be used even when Unconscious.`
`While Wielding the Flame, you are shrouded in a violet-yellow corona of incinerating Glory, moving you to the first place in Initiative regardless of rolls; if used during another Creature's Turn, you interrupt them. This also confers a Buff to all of your Abilities equal to your pact Strength, makes you immune to any Conditions or mental domination, and causes all Creatures within your Engagement to suffer Chaos Damage.`
`Each Round spent Wielding the Flame requires you to roll Chaos Dice equal to your Pact Strength, suffering 1 Corruption for each Die that rolls face 6.`

`If two Binders Wield the Flame at once, their Initiatives are used to break the tie in Turn order.`
#### Buer, Cloven in Pentacles
	*"She who nurtures the downtrodden, second mother to the beggar, thief, and first to the Witch, we call your name and invite into our hearth. Meet our hospitality with your own, spirit of transformation and magic, teach us your ways, give us gifts, dwell in us."*

Ancient Buer, the Five-hooved Hag, Ork Mother, these are names from before, from the first Binders of Gaia, then called Witches. Hers is a less overtly sinister bargain, born from a kind of perverse maternity which she and her servants seem to genuinely espouse.

Binders seek Buer for Hexes, Magical arts of healing and harm. These are both identifiable from the use of a black iron Cauldron, the fetish-object used to focus the powers a Pact with Sacharine Buer.

**The Pact**
Buer styles herself as a patroness of the less fortunate, but her patronage does not discriminate between its beneficiaries.
`"Tread not the garden underfoot"-Buer regards the impoverished as her fruit, but with a gaze tolerant of tangles and thorns that most would recognize for weeds. Petty criminals, miscreants, thieves, pickpockets, beggars, orphans, urchins, and all rabble must be allowed to prosper in their own way, per the terms of your contract. Unless under threat of your own life or property, you are forbidden from interfering with them. Buer regards most misbehavior like a woodsman might slime and maggots, a necessary part of the lower world. Falling to Buer's Pact, apropos of her inclinations, causes your body to explode in a shower of filth laden with fertile spores and foul, nutritive juices.`

**Buer's Cauldren**
To use her Hexes, you must hold a Black Iron Cauldron in one or both Hands, this Object focuses her presence and can also be used in other ways. Creatures bled to death into the Cauldron (which never overflows with blood) grant you a Whisp, a Magical resource you can spend in the following ways:
- `To remove 1 Corruption at any time from yourself.`
- `To increase your effective Pact Strength with Buer for the next Turn, by 1.`
- `To shed a single point of Strain.`

**Buer's Hexes**
Buer's Hexes are White or Black, White Hexes can generally be Invoked without fear, while Black Hexes have two dangerous effects. First, Black Hexes harm, and mustn't be used against the terms of your Contract. *Second, whenever you Invoke a Black Hex, roll Chaos Dice equal to your Pact Strength, if any roll 6, you suffer 1 Corruption.*

*White Hexes*
- *Crude Balm*
	`Over the course of 10 Minutes, you mix a foul-smelling mixture of animal fat, blood, and bile. Even if these ingredients were poisonous, the resultant concoction dispells Infections and speeds Recovery Time by a number of Days equal to your Pact Strength.`
- *Bone Divination*
	`You cast a handful of knuckle-bones while focusing on a question, the GM will respond with either Weal or Woe, this takes 1 Minute, and you should remain cautious, as the meaning of Weal or Woe is ambiguous at best.`
- *White Sacrament*
	`For 2 AP, you bring both hands your mouth and expel a fragrent cloud of Magic Spores in a Burst with a Radius equal to your Pact Strength, centered on you. Allies in this Burst gain a Buff of 1 to all Tests, and Enemies suffer an equal penalty. The cloud lasts for 1 Round, and gives rise to a ring of white-button mushrooms within the next Day, if possible. These are edible and lightly psycho-active.`

*Black Hexes*
	*The Witch-hammer*
	`For 1 AP, you pronounce a Curse on a Space within 6 Meters. Within 1d6+1 simple-Turns a maul of midnight blackness pounds the area, inflicting Crushing Damage.`
	*Eyebite-Curse*
	`For 3 AP, your eyes begin to shine with a ruby-amber light. Each Round thereafter for 1 Minute, you can Gaze at a Creature for !0 AP, you instantly learn their deepest fear, if any, and make them Vulnerable equal to your Pact Strength for 1 Full-Turn.`
	*Black Smoke Rite*
	`After spending 6 AP, you belch an acrid pall of roiling ebony smoke with a Radius of 6 Meters. Every Creature you choose with Willpower less than your Fellowship, Pact Strength, and Corruption is Blinded for 6 Minutes. If their Willpower is lower by 6, they also become Frenzied for 1 Minute, and you can control their Actions forced by Frenzy. If it is lower by 6 Again, you gain complete control of their Actions for their next Turn, leaving them Blind and Frenzied thereafter.`

name: Custom Items
summary: Player-authored custom artifice items. These live OUTSIDE the PHB, so they are merged into the database on every import and are NEVER deleted when a new PHB version arrives (a custom item is never actually in the book).
body_md:
Player-authored custom artifice items. These live OUTSIDE the PHB, so they are
merged into the database on every import and are NEVER deleted when a new PHB
version arrives (a custom item is never actually in the book).

How to add one — copy the format of the PHB's Artifice chapter, and add:
- `*Made On*:` the PHB version you designed it against (e.g. v17).
- `*Status*:` optional — force `outdated` if you know it needs revisiting.
  If omitted, an item is flagged **outdated** automatically once the current PHB
  moves past the version it was made on.

#### Custom Artifice

*Flicker Shield*
	*Pattern*: Force, Shell, Else
	*Made On*: v17
	*Bulk*: T+3|*Cost*: 4,000×T×(Bulk)| *Activation*: 10|
	A prototype ward that stutters a moment out of sync, catching a blow before it has fully landed.
	`When Activated as a !0 AP Reaction to being Attacked, the triggering instance of Damage is skipped forward T Seconds and resolves at the start of your next Turn — you may Move before it lands. Each use Notches the Shield once.`

*Auld Lantern*
	*Pattern*: Star, Echo, Density
	*Made On*: v16
	*Bulk*: T|*Cost*: 800×T×(Bulk)| *Activation*: 1|
	An older design kept for sentiment — its light lingers where you have already been.
	`Each Activation emits white light within 10T Meters for 1 Minute, and leaves a faint after-image of that light in each Space you left during the Duration for one further Round.`

#### Magical Items
Custom Magical Items designed by the group's GM. Where a value was left open, it is
GM-priced rather than buyable at a standard rate.

*Captain's Looking Glass*
	*Made On*: v17
	*Tier*: 3| *Cost*: 75,000| *Activation*: 1|
	A masterwork spyglass that folds several Runic devices into one brass barrel.
	`Integrated Scopes extend your Vision up to 500T Meters for 1 Minute per Activation.`
	`Heat Addon — your Vision switches to detecting heat sources instead.`
	`Integrated Greenlights let you see in complete darkness for T Minutes, cast in a colourless viridian hue; exposure to bright light while active Blinds you.`
	`Time Sight (costs T Plug Activations) — you gain a Preemption bonus up to T and learn everything that happened within the Space over the past T Minutes.`

*Heat Vision Goggles*
	*Made On*: v17
	*Tier*: 3| *Cost*: 45,000| *Activation*: 1 Plug|
	Bulky lenses that render the warmth of living things in glowing relief.
	`After Activation, you perceive heat sources out to your regular Vision range. This counts as a Direct Sense that bypasses Soft Cover such as fog or smoke.`

*Cloak of Many Stances*
	*Made On*: v17
	*Tier*: 3| *Bulk*: 3| *Cost*: 160,000|
	A billowing cloak that seems to move despite the absence of any wind.
	`You gain an additional 10 AP Reaction, usable only to change your Stances.`

*Timer*
	*Made On*: v17
	*Cost*: 250×T×(Bulk of the Consumable)|
	A clockwork Rune affixed to a Consumable to set it off on a delay.
	`Placed on a Consumable as a 1 AP Action. Set a countdown equal to T Full-Turns; the Consumable Activates when it completes. Multiply the Cost by 10 for a timer measured in Minutes instead.`

*Motion Sensor*
	*Made On*: v17
	*Cost*: 500×T×(Bulk of the Consumable)|
	A watchful Rune that trips a Consumable when the wrong thing draws near.
	`On Activation, designate Creatures and place the Sensor on a Consumable. It triggers that Consumable when any non-designated Creature Moves within T Meters.`

*Phase Shield*
	*Made On*: v17
	*Tier*: 3| *Bulk*: 3| *Cost*: 30,000| *Activation*: 1 Power Plug or 1 Loop (10 Plugs)|
	A one-handed magical Shield (Durability 6) that slips a moment out of phase.
	`Form of Fit — the hand holding it counts as technically free, but Tests using that hand and single-hand Weapon Attacks suffer a Bane.`
	`Extension Field — passively extends the benefits of your Iron Stance to Allies within your Engagement.`
	`Hard Cover — provides T Cover to everything in the Shield's Engagement; a missed Attack against those it covers always Damages the Shield instead.`

*Shard Dome*
	*Made On*: v17
	*Tier*: 3| *Cost*: 80,000|
	A deployable canopy of interlocking Residue shards that bristles against incoming fire (Reload_3, Craft_Metal).
	`Anti-Missile Defense — as a 0 AP Reaction to a Ranged Attack, negate its Damage instead of suffering it.`
	`Push-Back Protocol — as a 0 AP Reaction to a Melee Attack, push the attacking Creature as if Powerful_T before the Attack resolves.`

#### Ordnance
Artifice-built firearms. They carry full weapon profiles, but are Magical Items rather
than standard arms — each consumes Residue to fire.

*Launcher*
	*Made On*: v17
	*Tier*: 3| *Bulk*: 8| *Cost*: 50,000| *Activation*: 1 Plug to fire|
	A shoulder-braced tube of Artifice that hurls heavy objects at ferocious speed.
	`Ranged Weapon — Range 100, Accuracy 0, Durability 4, Traits: 2_Handed, Reload_3, Crushing, Craft_Metal.`
	`Loads and launches an Object of up to 30 Bulk. Each 10 Bulk of the loaded Object increases the shot's Vicious Quality by 1.`

*Big Fucking Shell*
	*Made On*: v17
	*Tier*: 3| *Bulk*: 30| *Cost*: 2,000|
	Ammunition for the Launcher — a massive iron shell built to carry a payload.
	`Launcher only. A shot made with a Big Fucking Shell has Bulk 30 and can carry an explosive payload (usually a grenade).`

*Dragon*
	*Made On*: v17
	*Tier*: 3| *Bulk*: 8| *Cost*: 50,000| *Activation*: 1 Plug to fire|
	A unique hand-cannon built for a single devastating short-range blast.
	`Ranged Weapon — Range 30, Accuracy 0, Durability 6, Traits: 1_Handed, Reload_3, Piercing, Vicious_3.`
	`Fires a solid iron ball or a spray of ball bearings in place of a bolt. Within 5 Meters it loses all Vicious and instead deals Traumatic Damage.`

#### Augmented Equipment
Weapon enchantments, applied to an existing Weapon the way the PHB's Augmentation Runes are.

*Impact*
	*Pattern*: Force, Touch, Weight, Cohesion
	*Made On*: v17
	*Cost*: 1,500×T×(Weapon Tier+6)| *Activation*: 1|
	*Equipment*: Any Melee Weapon that deals Crushing or Traumatic Damage
	It seems to pulse with energy, veins of glowing blue Residue running throughout.
	`When Activated, the Weapon gains the Powerful Trait, increased by T, for T Rounds. A Creature or Object it successfully strikes suffers additional Damage when it collides with something else.`

*Graviton Relay*
	*Made On*: v17
	*Cost*: 3,000×T×(Weapon Tier+6)| *Activation*: 1 Power Plug|
	*Equipment*: Any Weapon that deals Crushing Damage
	A denser cousin of Impact, wound tight around a caged core of gravity.
	`As a 1 AP Action fuelled by a Power Residue Plug, increase the Weapon's Powerful Quality by a multiple of T. The Weapon creates a Burst of T, pushing Creatures T Meters. The Enchantment fades after each strike.`

#### Relics
Unique found artifacts — not manufactured by Artifice, so they carry no Runic Pattern
and no standard price. They are one-of-a-kind and never for sale.

*Convenient Canvasbag*
	*Made On*: v17
	*Bulk*: 3|
	This bag has seen better days. Yet for its age, it seems remarkably intact.
	`Acts as a conduit to another space. Reach a hand inside while thinking of a stored Item to summon it. Contents are frozen in time within. Overturning the bag spills everything it holds.`

*Old Mining Pick*
	*Made On*: v17
	*Bulk*: 6|
	A shining pick made of an unknown metal, scribed entirely with runes.
	`Striking a stone Object with it immediately Breaks that Object.`

*Spiral Ring*
	*Made On*: v17
	*Bulk*: —|
	A gold band etched with faint, shifting runes that seem to rearrange when not directly observed, set with a deep violet gemstone that turns with an inner spiral of light.
	`Spatial Distortion — as part of a Movement Action, teleport to any visible Space within your Movement range. Observers see you collapse into purple light and reappear elsewhere.`

name: Custom Items
summary: Player-authored custom Consumables. Like the custom Artifice, these live OUTSIDE the PHB — they are merged into the database on every import, are NEVER deleted when a new PHB version arrives, and are tagged custom so nobody mistakes them for standard, buyable stock.
body_md:
Player-authored custom Consumables. Like the custom Artifice, these live OUTSIDE the
PHB — they are merged into the database on every import, are NEVER deleted when a new
PHB version arrives, and are tagged **custom** so nobody mistakes them for standard,
buyable stock.

How to add one — copy the format of the PHB's Consumables chapter (the bare backtick
Trait line, `*Cost*:`, a description, `*Effects*:`, `*Overdose*:`, `*Withdrawal*:`), and add:
- `*Made On*:` the PHB version you designed it against (e.g. v17).
- `*Status*:` optional — force `outdated` if you know it needs revisiting. If omitted, an
  item is flagged **outdated** automatically once the current PHB moves past its version.

#### Poisons

**Agony**
	`Tier_3, Active_1 Minute/1 Day, Deadly_18, Contact, Edible`
	*Made On*: v17
	*Cost*: 500
	A wracking alchemical toxin with a fearsome reputation — even a brushing contact is enough.
	*Effects*: `An inexplicable pain wrenches through your body, provoking Major Panic. You are Stunned_2 for the Duration.`
	*Overdose*: `Roll 1d6 Chaos Dice; on any result but a 6, you die within one Minute.`

name: Custom Items
summary: Player-authored custom Magic Items — Gaea. These are NOT products of Artifice; usually the work of Arcane Magic or some other means. They live outside the PHB and are tagged Gaea (their origin) and Custom (outside the book). Format matches the PHB item chapters.
body_md:
Origin: Gaea

Player-authored custom Magic Items — Gaea. These are NOT products of Artifice; usually the
work of Arcane Magic or some other means. They live outside the PHB and are tagged Gaea
(their origin) and Custom (outside the book). Format matches the PHB item chapters.

Magic Items can be Repaired like any other, but require expertise (Immanence, or other
familiarity with Magical craft) and Aether up to thrice their Tier (Aetheric Residue may
substitute at 100 to 1).

## Magical Items

Magic Item: **Traveler's Cloak**
	*Tier*: 1| *Cost*: 1,000| *Bulk*: 3| *Durability*: 6
	`With a 1_AP Interaction and a free Hand, change this Cloak into any of: a simple knife (Cutting/Piercing, Light); a lamp with a magical tongue of flame; a 1-Meter circular mirror; a sturdy wooden pole up to 3 Meters; 10 Meters of strong rope.`
	`Deep Pockets: an inner lining magically stores up to 10 Bulk.`

Magic Item: **Scout's Cloak**
	*Tier*: 1| *Cost*: 2,000| *Bulk*: 2| *Durability*: 6
	`With a 1_AP Interaction and a free Hand, change into any of: 10 Meters of sturdy rope with a grapnel; a Black Pine pole up to 10 Meters that bears 100 Bulk; a floating disk holding 100 Bulk that follows within 1 Meter (unless commanded to stop).`
	`Notch it once for: Reaction_1 — you and up to 3 Creatures within 10 Meters take no Falling Damage for 1 Round; or Movement_1 — your next Leap this Round costs 0_AP and has thrice the Distance.`

Magic Item: **Lesser Ring of Flame**
	*Tier*: 1| *Cost*: 3,000| *Bulk*: 0| *Durability*: 6
	`The Wearer gains DR:1_Incendiary and Resistance to Incendiary up to their Tier.`
	`The Word of Fire — General_1: light a Space within 10 Meters on Fire for at least 1 Minute. General_1: extinguish up to 2d6 burning Spaces within 10 Meters. Reaction_0: when suffering Incendiary Damage, Notch the Ring any number of times to reduce the Damage by as much.`

Magic Item: **Lesser Ring of Water**
	*Tier*: 1| *Cost*: 3,000| *Bulk*: 0| *Durability*: 6
	`The Wearer may walk on water as solid ground, or fall through it at will, and gains Resistance:2_Frost.`
	`The Word of the Sea — General_1: move up to 3 Spaces of Water within 10 Meters, freezing or thawing it (ice has 3 Durability per Space; a Creature encased is Restrained). General_1: know the direction of the nearest water source within 10 Kilometers. General_1: summon up to 10 Spaces of water from within 100 Meters (Notches the Ring).`

Magic Item: **Lesser Ring of Air**
	*Tier*: 1| *Cost*: 3,000| *Bulk*: 0| *Durability*: 6
	`The Wearer is Lighter by up to 10 at will, and gains Resistance:2_Voltaic.`
	`The Word of the Sky — Movement_1: move up to 10 Meters in any direction, or cease Falling instantly as a Reaction (no Damage). General_1: shape the air about you, making Ranged Attacks against you Harder by your Tier. General_1: manipulate winds within 10 Meters as your Hands — this can wield a Weapon at range for 1 Minute (Notches the Ring).`

Magic Item: **Lesser Ring of Earth**
	*Tier*: 1| *Cost*: 3,000| *Bulk*: 0| *Durability*: 6
	`The Wearer's Reserve is greater by 1 and their Encumbrance is raised by 10.`
	`The Word of the Mountain — General_1: mold up to 3 Spaces of earth or rock within 10 Meters (stone with Durability over thrice your Tier is immune). General_1: all plants and soil within 10 Meters act as your Hands for 1 Interaction. Reaction_1: reduce any Damage by twice your Tier, or negate forced movement for 1 Round (Notches the Ring).`

Magic Item: **Lesser Ring of Metal**
	*Tier*: 1| *Cost*: 3,000| *Bulk*: 0| *Durability*: 6
	`The Wearer's Attacks deal twice as much Damage to Objects, and Critical hits deal more Damage by their Tier.`
	`The Word of the Depths — General_1: a Melee Weapon you Touch elongates, gaining Reach for 1 Minute. General_1: your next Strike with a metal Weapon this Round is made with two Boons. General_1: a metal Weapon you Touch floats at your side for 1 Minute, dealing Blunted Damage to whatever you Strike, even on a miss (Notches the Ring).`

Magic Item: **Lesser Ring of Day**
	*Tier*: 1| *Cost*: 3,000| *Bulk*: 0| *Durability*: 6
	`The Wearer may Castigate themselves as a 0!_AP General Action. If Attacked while Castigated, the aggressor is also Castigated for 1 Round.`
	`The Word of the Sun — General_1: for 1 Minute, all Creatures within 10 Meters that can speak Communicate across any language (loose sense only). General_1: light everything within 30 Meters with Magical Sunlight for 1 Minute. General_1: shed an Injury by Notching the Ring — 1 for Minor, 3 for Moderate (not Major); or shed 3 Persistent Strain per Notch.`

Magic Item: **Lesser Ring of Night**
	*Tier*: 1| *Cost*: 3,000| *Bulk*: 0| *Durability*: 6
	`The Wearer sees in pitch Darkness as if it were Day, and automatically gains Soft Cover in shadows.`
	`The Word of the Moon — General_1: extinguish all non-magical lights (and Magical ones Tier_2 and below) within 30 Meters. General_1: manifest a silent visual illusion within 10 Meters, dispelled instantly by direct light. Movement_1: become invisible for 1 Minute (Notches the Ring).`

Magic Item: **Spirit Effigy**
	*Tier*: 1| *Cost*: 1,000| *Bulk*: 1| *Durability*: 1
	`A Spirit's power dwells within. Call it as a 1_AP Interaction to summon the Spirit to your aid for 5 Rounds, then roll a Chaos Die — on a 6 the Effigy is Notched. The maker chooses the Spirit at creation; the summoned being is an echo of its power, not the Spirit itself.`

Magic Item: **Catch-Pole**
	*Tier*: 1| *Cost*: 2,000| *Bulk*: 2| *Durability*: 10
	`Activate this 1-Meter rod with a 1_AP Interaction to freeze it relative to a frame of reference (the ground, a moving cart, etc.). While frozen it cannot be moved except by tremendous force — over 100 Bulk, or a Creature passing a DC_(30 − their Body) Vitality Test. Forced movement Notches it.`

Magic Item: **Farcalling Horn**
	*Tier*: 1| *Cost*: 1,000| *Bulk*: 1| *Durability*: 3
	`Sounding this horn sends a bright call, audible for over 30 Kilometers.`

Magic Item: **Rescue Banner**
	*Tier*: 1| *Cost*: 1,000| *Bulk*: 1| *Durability*: 10
	`Activate with a 1_AP Interaction: the flag emits a constant pulse of bright light straight up to the sky, visible for 100 Kilometers. Each Day of activation Notches the Banner.`

Magic Item: **Extensible Pole**
	*Tier*: 1| *Cost*: 1,000| *Bulk*: 3| *Durability*: 10
	`A wooden rod extended or shrunk with a 1_AP Interaction, from half a Meter to 20 Meters. It holds 100 Bulk before Notching, and extending it can push up to 100 Bulk against a solid backing.`
	`Thwack: used as a Quarterstaff, each Meter confers a scaling Reach property, but Attacks suffer an Accuracy penalty equal to that Reach.`

Magic Item: **Ring of Consecration**
	*Tier*: 1| *Cost*: 500| *Bulk*: 0| *Durability*: -
	`One of a pair. Once donned, a ring cannot be removed unless either Wearer speaks their denial aloud, which destroys both instantly. Both Wearers feel the other's emotional state, regardless of Distance.`

Magic Item: **Sentry Bell**
	*Tier*: 1| *Cost*: 1,000| *Bulk*: 1| *Durability*: -
	`Once hung, a Creature designates an area up to 30 Meters from it. Whenever a Creature enters that Radius, the Bell rings.`

Magic Item: **Dire Horn**
	*Tier*: 1| *Cost*: 6,000| *Bulk*: 2| *Durability*: -
	`Sound it with a 1_AP Interaction: Enemies that hear it within 30 Meters roll their next Test with a Bane, then are immune to its effect for 24 Hours.`

Magic Item: **Banner of the Line**
	*Tier*: 1| *Cost*: 6,000| *Bulk*: 3| *Durability*: -
	`Hold aloft as a 1_AP Interaction: all Allies that see it gain a Boon to their next Test, then are immune to its effect for 24 Hours.`

Magic Item: **Duelist's Talisman**
	*Tier*: 1| *Cost*: 500| *Bulk*: 1| *Durability*: -
	`Tear this Sealed slip (destroying it) to bind yourself and a visible Target into a ritual trial. Once Sealed, both must Coin-flip each time they would flee or take hostile Action against anyone but their partner. The ritual ends if either surrenders, is Incapacitated, or dies.`
	`The Weight of Ritual: if the Wielder receives aid of any kind against the Target after the ritual begins, it ends and the Wielder suffers 6 Corruption.`

Magic Item: **Talisman of Enmity**
	*Tier*: 1| *Cost*: 600| *Bulk*: 1| *Durability*: -
	`Speak the name written on this paper (you may write it yourself) to incinerate it, making all your Attacks against the named Target easier by 1 for the next Minute.`

Magic Item: **Talisman of Insight**
	*Tier*: 1| *Cost*: 100| *Bulk*: 0| *Durability*: -
	`Affix to an Item or Object and close its Seal with ink; the blank space instantly fills in: whether the subject is Magical; roughly what its Magical properties are; or, if no result can be obtained, why. This consumes the Talisman.`

Magic Item: **Divining Pendulum**
	*Tier*: 1| *Cost*: 2,000| *Bulk*: 1| *Durability*: -
	`Held in hand, speak a name etched on its four faces — Beast, Spirit, Man (a Creature with a self-aware Soul), or Abomination (a Creature lacking a Soul) — and it swings toward the nearest fitting Target within 100 Meters (excluding your own Engagement), or stays still if there are none.`

Magic Item: **Slip Shods**
	*Tier*: 1| *Cost*: 3,000| *Bulk*: 2| *Durability*: 6
	`Activate these Boots as a 0_AP Reaction to anything at all to Move up to your Movement without Provoking Attacks. This Notches the Shods.`

Magic Item: **Pale Dust**
	*Tier*: 1| *Cost*: 200| *Bulk*: 1| *Durability*: -
	`Cast this pouch (consuming it) up to 3 Meters away in a 3-Meter Radius. Illusions weaker than Tier_3 are instantly dispelled within; Dusted Targets lose Soft Cover, and Attacks against them are easier by 1. Simple washing removes it.`

Magic Item: **Bands of Bitter Iron**
	*Tier*: 1| *Cost*: 6,000| *Bulk*: 5| *Durability*: -
	`The Wearer may suffer Corruption to double their Reserve for 1 Minute.`

Magic Item: **Ruby Band of Revenge**
	*Tier*: 1| *Cost*: 4,000| *Bulk*: 0| *Durability*: 6
	`When Struck by Damage, the Wearer may inflict equal Incendiary Damage on the Attacker. This Notches the ring.`

Magic Item: **Solar Circlet**
	*Tier*: 1| *Cost*: 3,000| *Bulk*: 1| *Durability*: 6
	`When the Wearer would Risk Panic, they may Notch their Circlet instead.`

## Enchantments

Applied to equipment. More than one can usually be applied to the same piece, so long as
it qualifies by type.

Weapon Enchantment: **Shadow Tether**
	*Tier*: 1| *Cost*: 3,000| *Durability*: -
	`The Weapon is linked to a small piece of jewelry and can be Banished or Summoned for 1_AP. Banished, it vanishes, intangible; Summoned, it appears in the Wielder's Hand.`

Armor Enchantment: **Chain Link**
	*Tier*: 1| *Cost*: 6,000| *Durability*: -
	`The Armor is bound to a small piece of jewelry and can be Banished or Summoned for 0_AP. Banished, it vanishes; Summoned, the Wearer instantly dons it. You cannot Summon Armor while already wearing a set.`

Enchantment: **Bolster**
	*Tier*: 1| *Cost*: 4,000| *Durability*: -
	`Enchanted Armor confers Resistance to one of its Rated Damage Types, up to its Tier.`

Knife Enchantment: **Dusk Lotus**
	*Tier*: 1| *Cost*: 3,000| *Durability*: 3
	`Grants the engraved Technique — AP 1, General: you are wreathed in a cascade of black petals, gaining Soft Cover for 1 Minute; for the Duration your Strikes with the Knife deal more Damage by your Tier. Using it more than once in an Hour Notches the Enchantment.`

Knife Enchantment: **True-Bite**
	*Tier*: 1| *Cost*: 3,000| *Durability*: -
	`The Enchanted Knife ignores Soft Cover completely.`

Cleaver Enchantment: **Sky Tracer**
	*Tier*: 1| *Cost*: 3,000| *Durability*: 6
	`Grants the engraved Technique — AP 0, Movement: your Strikes this Round gain Reach up to twice your Tier; when spending more than one AP to Strike you may make (total AP − 1) extra Attacks that inflict Blunted Damage. Using it more than once in an Hour Notches the Enchantment.`

Polearm Enchantment: **Dragon Gouge**
	*Tier*: 1| *Cost*: 3,000| *Durability*: 6
	`Grants the engraved Technique — AP 3, Primary: Strike with the Polearm for 3_AP, gaining its Group Effect; the Attack resolves against everything in a line up to twice its Range. Using it more than once in an Hour Notches the Enchantment.`

Axe Enchantment: **Blood Haze**
	*Tier*: 1| *Cost*: 3,000| *Durability*: 6
	`Grants the engraved Technique — AP 0!, Stance: for the Duration you are Frenzied, may treat the Axe as Heavier by up to twice your Tier, and it is more Vicious by one. While Frenzied you cannot Resist Attacks with Skills, but may reduce Damage by 3 as a 0_AP Reaction that Notches the Enchantment.`

Bludgeon Enchantment: **World Hammer**
	*Tier*: 1| *Cost*: 3,000| *Durability*: 6
	`Grants the engraved Technique — AP 1, Reaction: when a Creature falls Prone or takes Falling Damage within 10 Meters, teleport to their Engagement and make a 1_AP Strike, Stunning them for Rounds up to your Tier on a hit.`

Bow Enchantment: **Displacer**
	*Tier*: 1| *Cost*: 3,000| *Durability*: 6
	`Grants the engraved Technique: instead of an Arrow, fire a bolt of pure force to the Bow's Range. When it hits, you may take any Action not dependent on an Item as if from that Space. Using it more than once in an Hour Notches the Enchantment.`

Weapon Enchantment: **Silver Trance**
	*Tier*: 1| *Cost*: 3,000| *Durability*: -
	`Grants the engraved Technique — AP 1, Stance: for the Duration you re-roll all Attacks and take the worse result; but if either result is a Critical Hit, you may take that result.`

Weapon Enchantment: **Fleeting Hex**
	*Tier*: 1| *Cost*: 3,000| *Durability*: -
	`When you miss a Creature with this Weapon, all Attacks against them are easier by 1 until the next time they are hit.`

	`The Wearer may suffer Corruption to double their Reserve for 1 Minute.`

Magic Item: **Ruby Band of Revenge**
	*Tier*: 1| *Cost*: 4,000| *Bulk*: 0| *Durability*: 6
	`When Struck by Damage, the Wearer may inflict equal Incendiary Damage on the Attacker. This Notches the ring.`

Magic Item: **Solar Circlet**
	*Tier*: 1| *Cost*: 3,000| *Bulk*: 1| *Durability*: 6
	`When the Wearer would Risk Panic, they may Notch their Circlet instead.`

## Enchantments

Applied to equipment. More than one can usually be applied to the same piece, so long as
it qualifies by type.

Weapon Enchantment: **Shadow Tether**
	*Tier*: 1| *Cost*: 3,000| *Durability*: -
	`The Weapon is linked to a small piece of jewelry and can be Banished or Summoned for 1_AP. Banished, it vanishes, intangible; Summoned, it appears in the Wielder's Hand.`

Armor Enchantment: **Chain Link**
	*Tier*: 1| *Cost*: 6,000| *Durability*: -
	`The Armor is bound to a small piece of jewelry and can be Banished or Summoned for 0_AP. Banished, it vanishes; Summoned, the Wearer instantly dons it. You cannot Summon Armor while already wearing a set.`

Enchantment: **Bolster**
	*Tier*: 1| *Cost*: 4,000| *Durability*: -
	`Enchanted Armor confers Resistance to one of its Rated Damage Types, up to its Tier.`

Knife Enchantment: **Dusk Lotus**
	*Tier*: 1| *Cost*: 3,000| *Durability*: 3
	`Grants the engraved Technique — AP 1, General: you are wreathed in a cascade of black petals, gaining Soft Cover for 1 Minute; for the Duration your Strikes with the Knife deal more Damage by your Tier. Using it more than once in an Hour Notches the Enchantment.`

Knife Enchantment: **True-Bite**
	*Tier*: 1| *Cost*: 3,000| *Durability*: -
	`The Enchanted Knife ignores Soft Cover completely.`

Cleaver Enchantment: **Sky Tracer**
	*Tier*: 1| *Cost*: 3,000| *Durability*: 6
	`Grants the engraved Technique — AP 0, Movement: your Strikes this Round gain Reach up to twice your Tier; when spending more than one AP to Strike you may make (total AP − 1) extra Attacks that inflict Blunted Damage. Using it more than once in an Hour Notches the Enchantment.`

Polearm Enchantment: **Dragon Gouge**
	*Tier*: 1| *Cost*: 3,000| *Durability*: 6
	`Grants the engraved Technique — AP 3, Primary: Strike with the Polearm for 3_AP, gaining its Group Effect; the Attack resolves against everything in a line up to twice its Range. Using it more than once in an Hour Notches the Enchantment.`

Axe Enchantment: **Blood Haze**
	*Tier*: 1| *Cost*: 3,000| *Durability*: 6
	`Grants the engraved Technique — AP 0!, Stance: for the Duration you are Frenzied, may treat the Axe as Heavier by up to twice your Tier, and it is more Vicious by one. While Frenzied you cannot Resist Attacks with Skills, but may reduce Damage by 3 as a 0_AP Reaction that Notches the Enchantment.`

Bludgeon Enchantment: **World Hammer**
	*Tier*: 1| *Cost*: 3,000| *Durability*: 6
	`Grants the engraved Technique — AP 1, Reaction: when a Creature falls Prone or takes Falling Damage within 10 Meters, teleport to their Engagement and make a 1_AP Strike, Stunning them for Rounds up to your Tier on a hit.`

Bow Enchantment: **Displacer**
	*Tier*: 1| *Cost*: 3,000| *Durability*: 6
	`Grants the engraved Technique: instead of an Arrow, fire a bolt of pure force to the Bow's Range. When it hits, you may take any Action not dependent on an Item as if from that Space. Using it more than once in an Hour Notches the Enchantment.`

Weapon Enchantment: **Silver Trance**
	*Tier*: 1| *Cost*: 3,000| *Durability*: -
	`Grants the engraved Technique — AP 1, Stance: for the Duration you re-roll all Attacks and take the worse result; but if either result is a Critical Hit, you may take that result.`

Weapon Enchantment: **Fleeting Hex**
	*Tier*: 1| *Cost*: 3,000| *Durability*: -
	`When you miss a Creature with this Weapon, all Attacks against them are easier by 1 until the next time they are hit.`

name: Custom Items
summary: Player-authored custom Martech — cybernetic Moduli ("Mods"), surgically implanted and fuelled by Residue held in Circulation by the User's Marian Core. These live outside the PHB and are tagged Custom. Format matches the PHB item chapters.
body_md:
Player-authored custom Martech — cybernetic Moduli ("Mods"), surgically implanted and
fuelled by Residue held in Circulation by the User's Marian Core. These live outside the
PHB and are tagged Custom. Format matches the PHB item chapters.

**Installing Martech** — every Mod requires a Marian Core (the only Mod installable with
no pre-requisite), a Trained Surgeon, and about a Week of implantation and recovery. Mods
are fuelled by Residue burned from the User's Core.

#### Visual Moduli
Modifications of the eyes — only two may be installed at once.

Mod: **Spyglass**
	*Tier*: 1| *Cost*: 6,000
	`Activate for 0_AP to gain a Buff to your next Spot Test in the same Round, up to 3 for each 10 Residue spent.`

Mod: **Brights**
	*Tier*: 1| *Cost*: 10,000
	`Activate for 1_AP to gain vision in total darkness, burning 10 Residue per Minute. The affected eye glows visibly for the Duration.`

Mod: **Archive**
	*Tier*: 2| *Cost*: 30,000
	`Activate as a 0_AP Reaction to store everything the affected eye sees in an integrated Plug of Temporal Residue. A Plug holds up to 1 Minute of continuous vision before it must be replaced.`

Mod: **Slice**
	*Tier*: 3| *Cost*: 200,000
	`Activate for 1_AP to pierce obstructions with the affected eye. This breaches anything with less than 10 Durability and burns 100 Residue per Minute (at least 10 per Activation).`

#### Manual Moduli
Modifications of the hands and arms — only two may be installed at once.

Mod: **Flex**
	*Tier*: 1| *Cost*: 4,000
	`Increases the Touch Range of the affected hand by 1 Meter. You may over-reach for one more Meter, but suffer a Bane to all Tests with that hand for the Duration.`

Mod: **Sinstra**
	*Tier*: 1| *Cost*: 3,000
	`Conceal anything up to 3 Bulk within the affected limb, escaping normal examination. Concealed Items may be equipped for 1_AP.`

Mod: **Dextra**
	*Tier*: 2| *Cost*: 6,000
	`Activate for 1_AP to attract or repel a metal Object up to 30 Meters away, of Bulk up to half the Residue spent. If worn/attached to a Creature, both move half as far. Repelled Objects inflict Crushing Damage on collision.`
	`Activate for 1_AP to pull yourself toward, or push yourself away from, a surface up to 10 Meters, burning 10 Residue.`

Mod: **Armiger**
	*Tier*: 3| *Cost*: 400,000
	*Range*: 60| *Accuracy*: -1| *Bulk*: 3| *Durable*: 10
	*Traits*: `Reload_1, Voltaic(3), Craft_Metal/Residue`
	`Instead of a hand, the affected limb holds an integrated heavy Arquebus with the above profile.`
	`Spend 60 extra Residue when Shooting to deal 1 Voltaic Damage in a 1-Meter Burst from the impact.`
	`Spend 1,000 Residue to make the next Shot in the same Round deal 1 more Damage, up to 10. Reloading burns 100 Residue.`

Mod: **Crushers**
	*Tier*: 3| *Cost*: 600,000
	`Both hands are taken up by this Mod. Your Unarmed Attacks lose the Blunt Trait; if you deal 3+ Damage with an Unarmed Attack you may change its Type to Traumatic; and your vertical lift becomes equal to your drag.`

Mod: **Dustbringer**
	*Tier*: 3| *Cost*: 600,000
	`Activate for 1_AP to deal 1 Chaos Damage within Touch Range of the affected hand (Objects instead suffer ten times as much Incendiary Damage). Anything killed or destroyed by this Damage is instantly turned to ash. Each Activation burns 100 Residue.`

#### Femoral Moduli
Modifications of the legs — only one may be installed at a time.

Mod: **Slope**
	*Tier*: 1| *Cost*: 10,000
	`Your Running Speed is increased by your Tier. Activate for 0_AP to stack this Bonus for 1 Minute, burning 10 Residue.`

Mod: **Coils**
	*Tier*: 2| *Cost*: 30,000
	`Activate for 0_AP and 10 Residue to triple the Distance of a Leap.`
	`Activate as a 1_AP Reaction and 3 Residue to automatically succeed a Roll.`
	`Activate as part of a kick (Unarmed Attack) to give it the Powerful Quality, up to half the Residue burned (up to 20).`

Mod: **Sky Breaker**
	*Tier*: 3| *Cost*: 800,000
	`Activate for 1_AP and 6 Residue per Minute to designate a point as your new down-direction.`
	`Activate for 0_AP and 10 Residue to become Weightless and gain a Flight Speed up to your Movement for one Round; spend more Residue per Round to extend it.`
	`Activate for 0!_AP and 6 Residue to Move up to 10 Meters in any direction.`

#### Dermal Moduli
Modifications of the skin and sub-surface — you may benefit from only one.

Mod: **Scales**
	*Tier*: ~| *Cost*: T1 6,000 · T2 60,000 · T3 600,000
	`Scales take effect when you wear no Armor, or your Armor is Broken: T1 Durability_3, Rating Physical/Voltaic; T2 Durability_4, Rating Physical/Energy; T3 Durability_6, Rating All.`

Mod: **Cloak**
	*Tier*: 2| *Cost*: 40,000
	`Activate as a 0!_AP Reaction to gain Soft Cover, burning 10 Residue per Round. Triple the Residue burned to also generate a 10-Meter Radius field of distortion that thwarts most Magical detection, masking your signal in low-level ambient Magic.`

#### Peripheral Moduli
Modifications of no particular system — install any combination.

Mod: **Marian Core**
	*Tier*: 1| *Cost*: 1,000
	`The pre-requisite for all further Moduli. The Core lets the User ingest Residue into their Circulation, where it can be burned by other Mods.`
	*Consumption*
	`Residue is ingested through a port (usually in the chest), able to load very concentrated amounts — potentially millions at a time. Ingesting takes time in Seconds equal to the amount of Residue.`
	*Preservation*
	`Circulating Residue cannot be extracted and is untouched even by Aether Vacuums, remaining until expended.`
	*Dissolution*
	`On the User's death, while Circulating more than 100,000 Residue, they detonate — dealing Explosive Damage in a Radius equal to 0.0001 times the Circulating amount.`

Mod: **Eta Cera**
	*Tier*: 1| *Cost*: 3,000
	`Grants an effective extra (or replacement) limb of any kind, functioning as the original body-part for almost all purposes. Extra arms give more hands, but do not allow installing more Manual Moduli than otherwise possible.`

Mod: **Surge**
	*Tier*: 2| *Cost*: 60,000
	`Burn Residue to shed Strain (no Action required): 30 Residue per Standard, 600 Residue per Persistent.`

Mod: **Physo**
	*Tier*: 3| *Cost*: 300,000
	`Activate as a 1_AP Interaction to instantly end your Bleeding. You may also burn 100 Residue (no Action) to reduce the Healing Time of one of your Injuries by one Day. Fully Healing an Injury with a Physo inflicts one Corruption.`

Mod: **Resera**
	*Tier*: 3| *Cost*: 1,000,000
	`When you would be killed, burn 1,000 Residue to be Incapacitated instead. For 10,000 Residue, ignore an instance of Damage completely.`
